headline: 本周影剧速览：爱情假说领跑，女巫团学院首播
summary: 本周电影《爱情假说》《挖掘者》等热作领跑，新剧《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》首播；《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》等持续热播，待映片《复仇者联盟5》受关注。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《爱情假说》《挖掘者》《野兽之心》等本周领跑。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: The Love Hypothesis, The Digger, and Heart of the Beast lead this week.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》本周开播。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Witch Academy and Gear Up debut this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》等热度延续。
industryHighlights.en: Hit series: The Rookie, Rick and Morty, and House of the Dragon keep momentum.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》《泥面人》等蓄势待发。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: Avengers 5, Meerkat, and Clayface await release.

headlineEn: This Week in Film & TV: Love Hypothesis Leads, Witch Academy Premieres
summaryEn: This week, films like The Love Hypothesis and The Digger lead movie buzz, while new series Witch Academy and Gear Up premiere; The Rookie and Rick and Morty remain hot, with Avengers 5 upcoming.
